longTitle.officialTitle: To extend and authorize annual appropriations for the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom through December 31, 2028.

enactingFormula.i: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representa­tives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “United States Commission on International Religious Freedom Reauthorization Act of 2026”.

section.heading: UNITED STATES COMMISSION ON INTERNATIONAL RELIGIOUS FREEDOM.

subsection.heading: Authorization of Appropriations.—
subsection.content: Section 207(a) of the International Religious Freedom Act of 1998 (22 U.S.C. 6435(a)) is amended by striking “2025 and 2026” and inserting “2027 and 2028, and for the period beginning on October 1, 2028, and ending on December 31, 2028”.

subsection.heading: Extension of Authorization.—
subsection.content: Section 209 of the International Religious Freedom Act of 1998 (22 U.S.C. 6436) is amended by striking “September 30, 2026” and inserting “December 31, 2028”.

signature.role: Speaker of the House of Representatives.
Vice President of the United States and President of the Senate.
